mechanism: Isotretinoin is teratogenic and requires strict pregnancy prevention; lisdexamfetamine may increase cardiovascular stress and psychiatric effects that complicate isotretinoin monitoring; both drugs can affect mood and behavior requiring careful oversight.
action: Monitor cardiovascular status and psychiatric symptoms closely; ensure patient is enrolled in iPLEDGE program; avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use effective contraception and frequent monitoring for mood changes and suicidal ideation.
